name: Austin Gipaldi
original_name: オースティン＝ジペルディ
source:
The King's counselor.
The younger brother of the former king Heintz and [url=/c54026]Edgar[/url] and [url=/c54032]Cossette's[/url] father.
He advises about the kingdom with composed eyes and always sincerely thinks about the country's affairs.
[url=/c54034]Simone[/url] is his wife.

(CV.凛理戒)
